(kha)༄༅/ /paṇḍi ta dā na shī la nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub skor rnams bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ārya a tsa la sā dha naṃ/ba

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// paṇḍi ta dā na shī la nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya a tsa la sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar sngags pas gsum la skyabs song zhing*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed byas rjes su// skad cig tsam gyis stong par rab dmigs nas// rab dkar padma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor blta// de ltar mgon po mi 'khrugs sku mdog dkar// g.yas g.yon phyag gis ral gri sdigs mdzub mdzad// zhabs gnyis

g.yon btsugs pus mo'i mthil gyis rab bzhugs pa// rin chen dar gyis brgyan pa bsgom par bya// lhag pa'i khro rgyal de yi mdun du yang*// de nyid ji lta'i bcom ldan 'das bsam bya/ ye shes sems dpa'/ /de dag thugs kar padma nyi ma la// hūm̐ dgu las gzhan gyis bskor ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba blta// de nas yi ge 'bru bcu bzlas byas te// sngags phreng kha nas khar rang gi mdun gyi zhugs ye shes dgug /lte ba nas 'thon slar zhugs bdag nyid kyi// snying gar bslan pa 'khor lo bzhin du bsam// de ltar zhag grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu// thun gsum nyid du sgom pa gang yin de// bka' dang bstan bcos kun gyi tshig dang don// bltas pa tsam gyis khong du chud par 'gyur// gzhan yang kun la mi 'jigs spobs pa thob// snyan dngags bstan bcos thogs med rtsom nus shing*// de yi smra ba sus kyang zlog mi nus// de phyir 'di 'dra gang du'ang rnyed par dka'// 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so/ 'di la lhug pa zhig kyang snang*/ /rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī las rang 'gyur mdzad pa'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes snang ba skyed pa'i phyir// shes rab blo 'phel gsal bar brjod// 'dir 'khor ba'i rgyu ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas thar pa'i rgyu yang dag pa'i ye shes bskyed par 'dod pas/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum la 'jug cing*/ de nyid myur du mthar phyin par byed pa'i rgyu shes rab yin zhing*/ de dag sgrub pa'i tshul yang mang du gsungs pa las/ skabs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das gtum po dkar po'i blo 'phel shin tu zab cing tshegs chung ba'i gdams ngag bshad pa la tshul gsum ste/ bka' babs brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ nyams len gdams pa'i gnad dngos dang*/

de nyid bsgrubs pa'i phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje khro rgyal mi g.yo dkar// grub thob 'od byed 'byung gnas paṇa chen shākya shrī// mkhas pa dā na shī la 'dul 'dzin byang chub sems// rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhes pa ste/ bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rjes thugs kyi sprul pa'i gtso bo khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'i lha tshogs bkye zhing*/ de yang zhi bas 'dul ba'i snang ngor mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rnam par snang la/ de nyid paṇḍi ta chen po grub thob 'od byed 'byung gnas zhes bya bas dngos su gzigs te/ byin gyis brlabs/ gsung phyung*/ lung bstan par gyur to// des kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī la gnang*/ des shar phyogs dza ga ta'i paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī la la gnang*/ des yar lung gi bla ma 'dul 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lung gi dbang phyug dharme shwa ra gnyis la gnang*/ de gnyis kyis mkhas pa yon tan khri bdag la gnang ste/ kho bos ni 'di nyid tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ dngos sam rmi lam du sku sna tshogs bstan cing*/ gsung phyung nas shin tu rjes su bzung ba yid ches par gyur te/ de ltar na ring brgyud kyi lnga'am drug nye brgyud ni gnyis kyang yin la/ bdag gis ni bla ma sa skya pa las brgyud pa'ang thos so// gnyis pa nyams len gdams pa dngos ni/ 'di nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bya ba gsum la bslab par bya ba las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ bla ma las 'di'i lung gi rjes gnang dang man ngag thob cing*/ rjes su brtson pa'i gang zag gis/ rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ gnas dang gos la sogs pa shin tu gtsang bar byas nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ thog mar bla ma dang dkon mchog dang yi dam la shin tu gus pa'i tshul gyis skyabs 'gro mang du bya'o// gnyis pa bsam pa khyad par can byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/

de nas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal zhing*/ rig pa'i ye shes chen po bskyed pa'i don du bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po'i shes rab blo 'phel 'di sgrub cing sgom bzlas bya snyam du sems bskyed bya'o// gsum pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ stong pa'i ngang las sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa dang*/ de'i ngang las sngags bzla zhing*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pas ngag tu/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas gzhi ma grub pa'i rang bzhin te/ stong nyid yin snyam du blo brtan par byas pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs de nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i zhing khams shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba yin snyam du bsams la/ de'i dkyil du skad cig gis pam̐ las padma dkar po dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rang gi rnam shes ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yi ge hūm̐ dkar po zhig tu bsam zhing de las 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud kyi ma dag pa thams cad ma lus par sbyangs nas slar 'dus pa las rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phreng ba la nyi ma shar ba ltar shin tu dkar zhing*/ 'od zer du ma rab tu 'phro ba zhal gcig pa/ ljags rnam par 'gyur ba can/ mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pas cung zad 'dzum la khro ba/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du skyod pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang sbrul ljang sngon bcings shing*/ mi bskyod rdo rjes dbu la brgyan pa/ spyan gsum rab tu g.yo ba dang ldan zhing*/ smin ma dang smra ra kham pa gyen du gzings pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas ye shes kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas sdig mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse la rdo rje'i zhags pa lan gsum dkris pa'i rtse mor gser gyi rdo rje phyed pa re 'dzin cing phrag gong du lding ba/

zhabs gnyis kyi g.yas pa pad nyi'i gdan la cung zad tsog pur bzhugs shing g.yon pa'i pus mo'i lha nga stan la bgrad par bcugs pa/ sku la rin chen sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis brgyan zhing*/ dar ljang sngon gyi cod pan mdzes par 'phur ba/ sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs kyis dkris pa'i sku rags sbrul dkar po sta zur phyed par byas pa/ sku shin tu lang tsho dang ldan zhing*/ sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byad can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa gcig car krong gis bsgom par bya gsungs/ gnyis pa mdun du ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa ni/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gi bsgoms pa ci 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa' mdun du/ pad nyi'i gdan la cung zad tsam tshur la zhal lta ba'i tshul du bzhugs par bsgom gsungs/ gsum pa thun mong du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gsal gdab pa ni/ de gnyis ka'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar po/ de'i 'dab ma rtsibs bcu par yi ge bcu'i sngags phreng 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba res bskor ba bsgoms te/ de'i man ngag cung zad ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas sngags phreng 'bar ba rang bcom ldan 'das su bsgoms pa'i zhal nas thon/ mdun gyi de'i zhal du zhugs thugs kar thim/ yang mdun gyi de yi lte ba nas thon nas rang gi lte bar zhugs shing*/ thugs kar thim pa'i tshul 'khor lo bzhin du yang yang du 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ de'i tshe sngags kyi 'od zer gyi phreng ba des 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i nus mthu ji snyed yod pa thams cad khyer nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la sib kyis thim pas bdag gi shes bya'i gnas ma lus pa la mkhas pa'i shes rab dang*/

spobs pa dang*/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang*/ khro bo thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsgom zhing*/ nga rgyal bskyed pa'i ngang las sngags/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa de brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji snyed nus pa bzla bar bya ste/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ bzlas brjod byas tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra cher mi 'gyur ha cang chung ba'ang min// gug kyed klad kor tshogs rnams nyams par min// smra gzhan ma yin gzhan du yengs pa min// zhes 'byung ba ltar bya zhing mthar 'phro gcod pa na ye shes pa hūm̐ du gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐ rang gi thugs kar bsdu/ skabs 'dir bogs 'byin sdigs mdzub kyi sbyor ba'ang bya zhing*/ mtshan mo nyal khar le brgan dar gyi sbyor ba'ang bya ste/ bla ma'i zhal las shes so// yang grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ 'bum phrag bcu'i bar du bzlas pas rdzogs/ dus kyi bsnyen pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig yin la/ rtags dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis te/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'di'i thun 'phro gcod pa na/ chos thams cad sgyu ma tsam du mos pa'i ngang nas/ gnas skabs su rang nyid ci 'dod pa'i smon lam btab ste/ mthar thug dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis bya zhing kho bos byas pa'i yan lag bdun gyi mchod bstod rgyas bsdus yang yang byas la 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ khyad par du gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na dku bag dang ma 'dres pa'i gtor ma mdun du bshams te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ma dag pa thams cad bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las yi ge gsum las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho tshad med par byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun mi g.yo ba'i lha tshogs padma nyi ma'i steng du spyan drangs nas gtor ma phul bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha cung zad phye la/ ngag tu yi ge bcu pa gsum mam/ bdun brjod pa phul nas gsol bar bsams te/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod cing*/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*// sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad// 'jigs byed chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*// srid pa gsum la dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de// srid pa'i chu bo skems shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms// srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje mi g.yo mgon// rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba 'khor bcas kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas thams cad la/ rkyen phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar cad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad grub cing shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa dang*/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ sprul pa bdag la bsdus te/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar gtor ro// gsum pa ni/ 'di nyid bsgrubs pa la phan yon ci yod ce na/

tshigs bcad drug pa'i gzhung las/ de ltar zhag grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu// thun gsum nyid du bsgrub pa gang yin des// bka' dang bstan bcos rnams kyi tshig dang don// bltas pa tsam gyis khong du chud par 'gyur// gzhan yang kun la mi 'jigs spobs pa thob// bstan bcos snyan ngag thogs med rtsom nus shing*// de yis smra ba sus kyang zlog mi nus// de phyir 'di 'dra shin tu rnyed par dka'// zhes bshad pa ltar gnas skabs su 'byung zhing*/ mthar thugs lam rim gyis bgrod nas/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'i// ye shes sgrub pa'i gdams ngag 'di// gzhung dang man ngag la brten nas// mkhas pa yon tan khri yis sbyar// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro kun dpal ldan bgrod par shog /bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po'i shes rab blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs bcud kyi snying po bkod pa zhes bya ba bod yul dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa yar lung gi mkhas pa yon tan khris sbyar ba yongs su rdzogs so// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i zhal gdams gsum gyi dang po ni/ rang dam tshig par bskyed/ mdun du ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa'i/ rang gi snying padma cung zad kha bye ba lta bu'i nang du/ padma nyid la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa dkar po'i mdun gyi rtsibs nas g.yon skor du rtsibs re la yi ge bcu pa re re/ mgo gyen bstan du bkod pa'i 'khor lo'i lte ba la ma 'byar ba'i pad nyi la mi g.yo ba tshon gang pa'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig kha dog mar me rab tu 'bar ba mi g.yo ba lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom/ rang gi ji lta ba bzhin mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar yang gong bzhin du bsam/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'khor lo g.yas skor du 'khor ba dang oṃ nas sngags 'bru re bzla/

mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags phreng 'phros/ rang gi zhal nas thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i zhal du zhugs/ de'i thugs ka'i mi g.yo ba'i zhal nas/ thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ yang de las sngags byung bas 'khor lo'i yi ge so so la thim/ yang de so so las sngags phreng byung nas/ lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte bar zhugs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim par bsams la/ spro bsdu la sogs mngon rtogs bzhin du bsam mo// bogs 'byin sdigs mdzub kyi sbyor ba ni/ thun 'phro bcad nas mdun gyi mi g.yo ba rang la thim pa'i rjes la/ phreng ba lag rtse skor nyi shu rtsa gcig lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sdigs mdzub byas pa'i gung mtheb kyis bzung*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi sdigs mdzub g.yas pa'i gung mtheb kyi sbu gur bcug pa lte ba'i thad du bzung nas lus bsrangs te sngags re dang phreng ba re bskyur ba bstun nas/ lag pa rim gyis kha'i thad du sleb pa dang nyer gcig gi tha ma phaṭa la sgra cher bya zhing*/ mig gyen du 'bru tshugs su blta/ lag pa gnyis sdigs mdzub byas la lag rtse skor bskyur nas/ sdigs mdzub lus kyi g.yas g.yon thad sor rgyang gis btang bas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye ba yin no// le brgan dar gyi sbyor ba'i zhal shes ni/ bsnyen pa thems nas dus kyi bsnyen pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi dus su/ dar dmar po kha gang la/ dri bzang gi chus sbags pa srod thun tshar nas nyal ba'i dus su/ gzhogs g.yas pa phab pa'i lag pa sngas kyi steng du kha gyen bstan byas pa la dar de bkab nas/ 'dun pa la da lan zhal mthong nges pas nyin mo byon na dngos su dngos grub len na'ang*/ mtshan mo gnyid kyi bar du byon na lag pa'i steng 'dir 'byon par mdzod cig bsams nas lag pa'i steng du nam byon dus gnyid sad yong bas de dus dngos grub zhu snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i ngang la gnyid pa yin/

zhal gdams gsum la sngar yi ge byas pa med do// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /rjes gnang ni/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po'i shes rab blo 'phel gyi byin rlabs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i man ngag ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sngon 'gro sbyor ba ni/ 'di'i byin rlabs dang man ngag gi lung dang ldan pa'i bla ma las/ slob ma dad mos dang ldan zhing*/ yang dag pa'i shes rab 'phel bar 'dod pas/ gnas khang gtsang zhing dben par rten mchod bshams pa'i mdun du mchod gtor ci 'byor legs par bshams te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ mchod yul

slob dpon lhar bskyed nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mdun du yi dam gyi lha bskyed la/ khyad par can la dpon slob gnyis char gyis/ mchod gtor gus pas 'bul zhing bsngo/ slob mas bla ma yi dam dbyer med du bsgoms pa la/ gus pas phyag dang maṇḍal phul te gang gi drin gyis sogs shlo ka gcig dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dngos// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa'ang mdzad/ thog mar bla ma'i rjes su thal mo sbyar nas/ na mo/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni sogs nas/ 'grub par shog gi bar/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsdus pa zhig blang gsungs/ yang na gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum mdzad/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rten 'brel du lung nod pa'i man ngag gsum bya ste/ thog mar byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ dpon slob gnyis char gyi lag tu me tog bzung bas thal mo sbyar ro// thog mar slob mas bla ma'i gsung gi rjes su gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhen lan gsum brjod de/ me tog bla ma yi dam dbyer med bsams la gus pas gtor de nas slob ma lhar bskyed pa la/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mi g.yo ba'i rnam par bstims pas skur byin gyis brlab/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsung rig sngags rnams yi ge bcu par spyan drangs nas slob ma'i mgrin par bstims par gsung du byin gyis brlab/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ral gri la sogs pa phyag mtshan spyan drangs nas/ slob ma'i thugs kar thim pas thugs su byin gyis brlabs pa rnams phyag len la mdzad do//

gsungs/ yang bla mas kyang*/ de'i rjes su bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med kyi/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thams cad slob ma'i rgyud la zhugs par bsams te slob ma'i spyi bor me tog 'thor zhing*/ ngag tu/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod gsungs/ gnyis pa rjes su bzlas lung ni/ yang bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med kyi gsung sngags grags stong gi rjes su slob mas bzlas pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thams cad rjes su zhugs par bsams te/ snying po sngags yi ge bcu pa nyid/ gus pas lan gsum bzlas par bya'o gsungs/ gsum pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ yang slob mas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i sgom bzlas 'di nyid ci 'grub tu bya snyam du sems bskyed de/ bla ma'i gsungs rjes su gus pas thal mo sbyar nas/ ngag tu/ bla ma dam pa rje btsun rin po ches/ bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i snying po sngags yi ge bcu pa nyid lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ rgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci nus su 'don zlos byed par dam 'cha' ba lags so// zhes lan gsum bzlas te/ don la'ang de ltar ci 'grub tu byas pas rgyud la yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs te/ de'i rjes la bla mas/ slob ma'i spyi bor gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid bzhag nas/ ngag tu/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas gdul bya slob ma'i tshogs 'di dag gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

'di dag gi nad gdon dgra bgegs dang bdud dang log 'dren gyi tshogs thams cad myur du zhi zhing bzlog par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang dbang thang dang nus mthu blo dang rig pa dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ gzugs dang ting nge 'dzin dang spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thams cad myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gcig brjod pas/ de ltar 'byung ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par bsam gsungs/ gsum pa rjes mjug gi bya ba ni/ bla ma'i rjes su slob mas/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// deng nas brtsams te khyod bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi// khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod nas/ rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad yid kyis bla ma yi dam dbyer mi phyed pa la phul bar bsams te/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag byas nas/ skabs 'dir 'di yi chos lung rgyas bsdus bya/ mthar gtor ma sa gtsang sar btang la bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po'i byin rlabs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gyi man ngag bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung ngag rin po che snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i yi ge med pa las/ dad ldan slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ gzhan phan brtse ba'i yid kyis tshig gi brjed byang tsam du yang dben chos kyi khang par mkhas pa yon tan khris bkod pa rdzogs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i lta ba bka' btags kyi phyag rgya'i nyams len gnad dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo/ shākya'i dge sbyong yon tan khri bdag gis/ dpal skyor mo lung gi chos grwa chen por shes bya'i gnas la yid kun tu rmongs pa spangs pa'i phyir/

khro rgyal mi g.yo ba dkar po'i shes rab blo 'phel ston zla ra ba'i zla ba la/ tshes gcig nas brtsams te zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i tshe de nyid kyi tshes bcu'i snga dro'i cha la sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu sgom bzlas byed cing mdun gyi nam mkhar cung zad bltas pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' shin tu dwangs shing sngon por snang ba'i dkyil na 'od kyi rnam pa rgya gram 'ja' tshon ris su 'khor ba'i thig le du mar snang ba'i dkyil so so na/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po'i lha tshogs dpag med gtso bo rigs lnga'i sku mdog can gyi rol pas bzhugs pa 'ol spyi tsam du mthong ba na/ kye ma 'di lta bu'i rnam 'phrul khyad par can 'byung ba ci zhig yin te/ ya mtshan che snyam nas/ slar mig btsums nas mos pa bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/ re zhig kho bo'i yid la 'di dag kyang ya mtshan che mod kyi 'on kyang mdun gyi skur snang ba 'di rnams rgyun du rtag gam mi rtag snyam nas nam mkhar bltas pa'i tshe/ shar gyi gtso bo dkar por snang bas gsungs pa 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ ni/ kyai skal ldan rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltar nyon// phyi nang 'dus byas thams cad gzhan du 'gyur zhing 'pho// gcig tu nges pa med cing sna tshogs so sor snang*// 'di la rtag par ma 'dzin bar snang glog ltar ltos// zhes gsungs so// yang kho bo'i shes pa la dga' bde cung zad skyes pas/ zag bcas 'khor ba'i nang na'ang 'di lta bu'i bde ba'i tshad byung ba ngo mtshar che snyam pa na/ lho phyogs kyi gtso bo ser por snang bas gsungs pa zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ ni/ kye ho/ shes ldan rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltar ltos// tshu rol 'khor ba'i mtho dman thams cad zag bcas yin// gang la bde bar btags kyang sdug bsngal mi zad rgyu// 'di la bde bar ma zhen dug can kha zas ltos// zhes gsungs so// yang kho bo'i bsam pa la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bde sdug so sor grub pa bden pa yin snyam du sems pa na/

nub kyi gtso bo dmar por snang bas gsungs pa chos thams cad bdag med pa/ ni/ e ma ho/ blo ldan rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltar gson// 'khor 'das snang srid chos rnams thams cad kyang*// nga dang bdag tu bzung bas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// 'di la bdag tu ma 'dzin sgyu ma lta bur ltos// zhes gsungs so// yang kho bo'i sems la 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin sna tshogs 'di spangs nas 'bras bu thar pa myang 'das zhig thob par bya snyam pa na/ byang gi gtso bo ljang gur snang bas gsungs pa myang 'das thams cad zhi ba/ ni/ e ma/ las can rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltar gzigs// 'bras bu myang 'das chos rnams spros pa'i mtshan ma zhi// gang la rtog pas brtags na thar mchog mi 'grub pas// 'di la mtshan mar ma zhen nam mkha'i dbyings ltar ltos// zhes gsungs so// yang kho bo'i sems la chos thams cad don la lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhir 'dus par gsungs kyang de nyid gang zag gi rgyud la don bsdus nas nyams len ji ltar byed snyam du sems pa na/ dbus kyi gtso bo dkar por snang ba'i zhal nas gsungs pa thabs shes zung du 'jug par/ ni/ e ma ho/ rig 'dzin rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltar soms// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos kun snang stong zung 'jug yin// gang la phyogs 'dzin zhugs na pha rol mi phyin pas// 'di la rtag chad ma lhung stong nyid snying rje'i snying por ltos// zhes gsungs pa na/ de nyid du phyi nang shes bya'i don thams cad la ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs thams cad chod nas nang du nges pa'i shes pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par skyes shing*/ lus sems la dga' bde phun sum tshogs pas kyang tshims par gyur to// yi dam gyi lha bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul cung zad snang ba/ tshig gi brjed byang tsam du dpal skyor mo lung gi chos grwa chen por yi ger btab pa gu hya// maṅga laṃ//

༈ /bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan/ rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wān a tsa la shuklā ya a bhi sa ma ya gu ṇa mu khā ta stott+ra saptāṅga ba tī nā maḥ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po la mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan zhe bya ba/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sna tshogs thabs kyis gdugs pa 'dul mdzad khro rgyal gyi// bcom ldan khyed la dad mos blo yi sems chags kyi// dbang po rdo rje'i dbyangs kyis yang dag bstod par bgyi// pad dkar 'dab brgyad rab mdzes dri bsung phun tshogs ldan// me shel dkyil 'khor rnam dag 'bar ba'i gdan steng du// srid gsum skyon gyis ma gos sprul pa'i gzugs kyis brjid// gdul bya smin mdzad khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa hūm̐ mchog las 'khrungs gangs ri'i phreng ltar dkar// 'bar ba'i 'od zer stong 'phro lhang nge lham mer 'tsher// kun rtog blo bur rnam dag ji bzhin brnyes pa'i sku// thugs rjes kun gzigs khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs pa'i tshul// g.yon brkyangs bgrad pa'i pus btsugs gar gyis rnam par rol// stong dang snying rje dbyer med srid zhi'i mthar phyin pa'i// mi gnas tshul 'chang khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sku la srab 'jam sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' gsol// rigs ldan dkar po'i sku rags sta zur 'phyang ba dkris// khrel yod ngo tsha'i gzhi 'dzin ye shes mdangs kyis mdzes// gsang ba'i dam tshig sdom mdzad khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gcig rnam g.yo ha ha bzhad pa'i sgra chen sgrogs// dmar zhing 'khrugs pa'i ljags kyis stong gsum ma lus 'gengs// yang dag dbyings las mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don la dgyes// srid pa'i mun sel khyed la gus pas phyag=

/rno dkar mche ba bzhi ni cung zad rab gtsigs shing*// spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yo ba'i sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// byams dang snying rje'i spyan gyis khams gsum don mdzad cing*// bdud dpung skrag mdzad khyod la gus pas phyag= /dbu skyes smin ma zhal tshom dmar ser gyen du 'bar// sbrul chen sna tshogs gzugs kyis dbu la gdengs kar dkris// rang rig ye shes mchog rgyal chu bdag dbang sdud cing*// thar mchog dkri mdzad khyod la gus pas phyag= /rin chen dbu rgyan lngas spras mi bskyod rigs kyis mtshan// sku la ljang sngon rab mdzes dar gyi cod pan 'phur// srid gsum rlung gis mi g.yo sku mchog ye shes ldan// snyan pa'i ba dan rab sgrogs khyod la gus pas phyag= /phyag gnyis g.yas kyis 'bar ba'i ral gri gyen du gdengs// g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub rdo rje'i zhags par dkris// bden gnyis rnam dag blo yis mi shes gcod mdzad cing*// dgra bgegs tshar gcod khyod la gus pas phyag= /sku dang yan lag mchog rgyas gzhon nu'i lang tshor ldan// rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan spras 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro// rnam dag mtshan dpe rab 'bar dgos 'dod yid bzhin stsol// srid gsum dbang mdzad khyod la gus pas= /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil chen po na// dpa' bo sgeg cing mi sdug 'jigs byed chen pos rol// ma rig 'thibs po'i tshogs rnams ma lus sreg mdzad cing*// rgyal ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad khyod la gus pas= /dam tshig sems dang ye shes sku gnyis dbyer med pa'i// thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ yig sa bon la// rig sngags rgyal pos bskor las 'od zer rab 'phros pas// 'khor ba rab 'joms khyod la gus pas= /khro bo'i ting 'dzin rab zab sngags phreng 'bar ba'i mthus// 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon tan ji snyed kun 'dus nas// thugs mchog rdo rje la zhugs sbas pa'i mthu stobs kyis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la gus pas=

/thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gsang sngags snying po las// rno gsal rgya chen brtan dang thogs med 'od 'bar bas// blo rig ye shes spyan dang ye shes gzungs thob cing*// spobs pa skyed mdzad khyod la gus pas= /drag chen khyod kyi gsang spyod zab mo bsten pa'i mthus// bka' dang bstan bcos lung rig man ngag rnam dag rnams// tshig don ji bzhin myur du blo yis legs rtogs shing*// mi brjed gzungs ster khyod la gus pas= /gtum chen khyod kyi byin rlabs myur mgyogs rgya chen gyis// snyan ngag sdeb sbyor tshig gi gnas la ma rmongs shing*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul la rnam dpyod thogs med pas// rgol bas mi brdzi khyod la gus pas= /brtson pas sgrub pa'i dus su nges par dam tshig bsten pa ste// sdigs mdzub las sbyor dang ni thun mtshams rnal 'byor mthus// gsang gsum phrin las rgya chen myur sgrub mdzad pa yi// mthu stobs dbang phyug khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// e ma ho// 'gro bas mchod pa 'bul ba/ bdag tu bzung dang ma bzung blo yis sdus// ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul las byung mchod rdzas ji snyed rnams// khyod la gus pas 'bul gyis thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/

sdig pa bshags pa /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i tshogs kyis dus gsum mtha' yas su// mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gis nyes pa ci bgyis rnams// thugs rje mchog ldan khyed la snying nas mthol bshags bgyi/ rjes su yi rang ba /rang gzhan skye 'phags rgyud kyis kun nas rab bsdus pa'i// zag bcas zag med dge ba ma lus thams cad la// shin tu dga' ba'i sems kyis rjes su yi rang bgyi/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul ba/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras nyan rang ma lus ji snyed pa// btang snyoms chen po'i tshul gyis zhi bar bzhugs rnams la'ang*// 'gro ba'i don du mi zad 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan mi 'da' bar bzhugs pa /dus gsum 'gro ba'i don la kun nas rab brtson pa'i// skyes mchog mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan par mdzad rnams la'ang*// rtag par gzhan don mdzad cing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten dge ba bsngo ba/ 'gro ba kun gyis dus gsum legs bsags pa'i// dge ba ma lus bsdus nas sems can thams cad kyis// byang chub myur du thob phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// e ma ho/ bcom ldan khro rgyal khyod nyid gus pas mchod bstod cing*// bsgoms bzlas mngon par bgyis pa'i dge ba gang yod des// khams gsum 'gro ba'i nyon mongs sprin tshogs rab bcom zhing*// snang dang stong pa'i rang bzhin tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te// zag bcas zag pa med bsdus lam dang 'bras bu'i chos// bdag sogs rmongs pa'i bu la nye bar stsal nas kyang*// gdug sems gnod 'tshe ma rungs kun nas nyer zhi ste// mthar 'dzin rlung gis mi bskyod brtan pa'i dngos grub stsol// dus gsum rgyal ba mi bskyod thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la gus pas legs bstod pa'i// dge chen rnam par mi zad rgya mtsho lta bu yis// srid par 'khyams pa'i 'gro rnams byang chub myur thob shog

/bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba dkar po la mngon par rtogs pa yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan zhes bya ba mkhas pa yon tan khris sbyar ba rdzogs so// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ skyabs su 'gro ba ci nus byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal te ye shes kyi snang ba khyad par can la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun mi g.yo ba dkar po bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes zhe thag pa nas lan gsum brjod/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su gyur/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems yi ge hūm̐ dkar po zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyangs nas slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar zhing 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas ye shes kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin cing rtse mo phrag gong du lding ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba cung zad 'dzum zhing khro ba spyan gsum rab tu g.yo ba/ sma ra dang smin ma 'khyug cing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul ljang sngon gyis bcings pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pa dang g.yon pa'i pus mo snyan la btsugs te bzhengs ma stabs su mdzad pa/

sgeg cing dpa'i ba'i cha byad can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mdun du spyan drangs pa pad nyi'i steng du rang nyid la zhal phyogs te bzhugs par gyur/ de gnyis ka'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i lte ba na reg la ma 'byar ba'i pad nyi la mi g.yo ba tshon gang pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig mar me ltar 'bar ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la sngags phreng yig 'bru bcu bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i mi g.yo ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung gnyis ka'i zhal nas thon/ mdun gyi mi g.yo ba phyi nang gnyis kyi zhal nas zhugs thugs kar thim/ de gnyis kyi lte ba nas thon/ rang dang snying ga'i mi g.yo ba'i lte ba nas zhugs/ thugs kar thim zhing 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba rgyun mi chad pa la sems gtad/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim par bsams la/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus pa'am/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag bcu bzla/ thun 'jog pa na mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' hūm̐ gi rnam par gyur nas rang gi thugs kar thim par bsams la dge ba bsngo'o// rjes gnang byed na/ mdun du mi g.yo ba'i bris sku'am/ ma 'byor na tshom bu bkod/ mchod gtor gsham/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la bdag bskyed bsgom/ mdun gyi dmigs rten bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las mi g.yo ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ ārya a tsa la zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rab dkar gangs ri'i mdog can brjid mdzes sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// pus btsugs 'gying zhing sgeg pa'i cha lugs can// blo ster mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ thal mo kha gyen du phye ste yi ge bcu pas phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob mas phyag dang rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i slad du/ slob mas slob dpon la me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rjes gnang dngos la byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ slob ma swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mi g.yo ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed la phog mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi g.yo ba'i rnam par spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus la thim pas lus lhar byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsung rig sngags thams cad yi ge bcu pa'i rnam pas slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas ngag sngags su byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes thams cad phyag mtshan ral gri dang zhags pa'i rnam par spyan drangs nas mthar 'od zer du zhu ste slob ma'i snying gar thim pas sems ye shes su byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/

me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon mi g.yo bar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung ba zhal nas thon slob ma mi g.yo bar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' skor du 'khod par bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum byed du gzhug gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad rgyud la zhugs par bsam mo// dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ slob mas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin zhing sgom bzlas ci nus bgyid snyam pa'i bsam pas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rje btsun rin po che thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ bdag la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus da nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin cing*/ de'i sgom bzlas ci nus bgyid par dam 'cha' lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod cing de ltar ci 'grub bya/ lus lha dang*/ ngag sngags dang*/ sems ye shes su shes par bya'o// de nas gtor ma mi g.yo bar bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gdul bya slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyi rlabs kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod/ blo dang rig pa/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

zhes brjod/ rjes gtso bos/ maṇḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ bris sku yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ tshom bu yin na ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba bsngo'o// mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa 'di ni/ don gnyer gyi slob ma rnams la phan pa'i ched du btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal snying por dril ba blo gros grub ster ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇā ya/ nges par 'byung ba dang byang chub sems gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing dbang dang rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas blo gros kyi mthu phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i slad du dpal gtum po dkar po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3haṃ/ skad cig tsam gyis stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// bhrūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i sngags kyi sgra gdangs las// sa phyogs thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i zhing*// yid 'phrog ngo mtshar bkod pa 'byams klas dbus// pam̐ las pad dkar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng*// sems nyid hūm̐ yig dkar po'i 'od zer gyis// snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs te rang la thim// de las rang nyid bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon// rab dkar ston zla gsar pa'i lang tsho la// khro zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum phyag g.yas kyis// ye shes ral gri 'bar ba mkha' la 'phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas rdo rje'i zhags// thugs kar 'chang ba'i sne mo phrag gong lding*// zhabs g.yas rting dang g.yon pa'i pus mo dag

/gdan la btsugs te bzhengs pa'i stabs su bzhugs// rin chen sbrul rgyan dar gyi na bzas bklubs// mi bskyod rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas te// snang stong dbang po'i gzhu bzhin gsal ba yi// thugs srog hūm̐ yig las byung 'od zer gyis// rang nyid ji lta'i bcom ldan mi g.yo ba// spyan drangs mdun du pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs// bdag mdun thugs kar padma dmar po ni// cung zad kha bye ge sar rgyas pa'i dbus// 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu'i lte ba ru// rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba// de yi thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐// rab 'bar snang bas rmongs pa'i mun pa 'joms// rtsibs bcur rig pa'i rgyal po 'bru res mtshan// bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'khor lo g.yas 'khor zhing*// sa bon 'khor lo'i yi ge las byung ba'i// sngags phreng bdag gi zhal nas mdun bskyed kyi// zhal du zhugs nas thugs srog nā dar thim// de las sngags kyi phreng ba rab 'phros pa// 'khor lo'i yi ge so sor thim pa las// so so'i sngags kyi gzugs byung lte ba nas// rang gi lte ba'i lam brgyud hūm̐ yig la// thim ste gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba yis// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub kun// bsdus nas snying ga'i sa bon gsos btab pas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i shes rab dang*// phun sum tshogs pa'i mthu stobs rgyas par gyur// oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i dmigs pa rtse gcig pas ji ltar nus pa bzlas mthar thun bsdu ba na/ mdun gyi lha hūm̐ gi rnam par gyur nas rang gi thugs kar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon pos rjes bzung nas// rig dang brtse ba nus pa rmad byung ba'i// thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te lhar snang sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas spyod lam la 'jug

bsnyen pa byed na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pa'i grangs 'bum phrag bcu kha skong dang bcas pa dang*/ dus zhag nyer gcig gi bar du thun gsum gyi rim pas nyams su blangs pa na lha'i gsal snang sogs rtags khyad par can byung ba'i tshe bogs 'byin sdigs mdzub kyi sbyor ba dang*/ le brgan dar gyi sbyor bas lha mngon sum du bsnyen pa ni yig rnying ltar shes par bya'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs su shes bya kun la 'jigs pa med pa'i 'chad pa dang*/ snyan ngag smra ba la thogs pa med pa'i rtsom pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsod pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa thob cing*/ khyad par shes rab 'chal ba'i gegs thams cad srung ba dang*/ mthar thugs lam rim gyis bgrod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob pa ni nges pa'o// zhes pa'ang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku karma nges don dbang pos bka' stsal rin po che'i phreng bas bskul ba ltar mang du thos pa'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos paṇḍi ta dā na shī la'i rgya gzhung dang*/ tshul 'di'i sgo nas dngos grub brnyes pa mkhas pa yon tan khri'i gsung rab las snying por dril te sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang la 'dod sgur rtsen pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ye shes rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// mi bskyod rdo rje khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon// 'od byed 'byung gnas paṇa chen shākya shrī// dā na shī la 'dul 'dzin byang chub sems// chos kyi dbang phyug rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dngos grub mchog brnyes mkhas pa yon tan khri// seng ge bzang po seng ge rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// bdag chen chos rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun spangs chen po tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs// ngag gi dbang po kun dga' bsod nams dang*// bsod nams dbang phyug rnams la=

/brgyud srol kun 'dus rmor chen chos kyi rje// legs pa'i 'byung gnas kun dga' blo gros dang*// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bsnyen sgrub bogs 'byin sbyor ba la brten nas// khro rgyal dbang pos mngon sum rjes bzung mthus// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes mthar son shog /ces pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'i siddhi rastu// //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
